tasks.title: DocumentConfig
tasks.description: Add a DocumentConfig pydantic model (chunk_size: int = 500, chunk_overlap: int = 50, max_file_size_mb: float = 20.0) to src/mcp_vectordb/config/config.py, wired into Settings and Settings.from_env() reading DOCUMENT_CHUNK_SIZE, DOCUMENT_CHUNK_OVERLAP, DOCUMENT_MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB env vars. Add the new env vars (commented, with defaults) to .env.example. TDD: test Settings.from_env() defaults and env-var overrides using monkeypatch.setenv. See docs/document-upload-tool/tasks.md T1 for full details.

tasks.title: Recursive chunking
tasks.description:
Implement recursive_chunk(text, chunk_size, chunk_overlap) -> List[str] in new src/mcp_vectordb/core/chunking.py. Splits on 

, then 
, then '. ', then falls back to a hard character window with overlap. Never returns empty-string chunks, never infinite-loops, raises ValueError if chunk_overlap >= chunk_size. Pure stdlib, no new dependency. See docs/document-upload-tool/tasks.md T2 for full test list and acceptance criteria.

tasks.title: Text extraction (PDF/TXT/MD)
tasks.description: Implement extract_text(file_path) -> List[Tuple[Optional[int], str]] in new src/mcp_vectordb/core/parsers.py. Dispatch by extension: .pdf via pypdf (per-page text, page_number starting at 1), .txt/.md read directly as a single (None, text) entry. Raise a clear error for unsupported extensions and a distinct parse-failure exception for corrupt PDFs. Add pypdf>=4.0.0 to requirements.txt. Add small test fixtures (sample.pdf, sample.txt, sample.md, and a corrupt PDF fixture) under tests/fixtures/. See docs/document-upload-tool/tasks.md T3 for full test list and acceptance criteria.

tasks.title: Validators
tasks.description: Add to src/mcp_vectordb/utils/validation.py: validate_file_path(path, allowed_extensions, max_file_size_mb) checking existence/readability/extension/size, raising ValidationError with a clear message per failure; validate_chunk_size(chunk_size); validate_chunk_overlap(chunk_overlap, chunk_size) (overlap >= 0 and < chunk_size). Extend the reserved-keys set used by validate_metadata (or add a sibling validator) to reject document_id, source_filename, file_type, page_number, chunk_index, total_chunks, uploaded_at as caller-supplied metadata keys. Must not regress existing validate_metadata/validate_text tests. See docs/document-upload-tool/tasks.md T4 for full test list and acceptance criteria.

tasks.title: upload_document MCP tool
tasks.description: Implement @mcp.tool() async def upload_document(file_path, collection='documents', metadata=None, document_id=None, chunk_size=None, chunk_overlap=None, ctx=None) -> str in new src/mcp_vectordb/tools/document.py, registered via src/mcp_vectordb/tools/__init__.py. Flow: validate inputs (T4 validators, DocumentConfig defaults from T1 when chunk_size/chunk_overlap are None) -> ctx.info start -> extract_text (T3) per page -> recursive_chunk (T2) per page with ctx.debug progress -> build one Document per chunk with document_id/source_filename/file_type/page_number/chunk_index/total_chunks/uploaded_at + merged user metadata -> auto-create collection if missing (reuse store_text pattern) -> batch-embed via embedding_service.generate_embeddings -> vector_db.store_documents -> return summary string -> three-tier exception handling matching store_text/similarity_search exactly. Also update README.md to document the new tool. See docs/document-upload-tool/tasks.md T5 for full test list and acceptance criteria.
